note: M5 starter set, designed from the existing balance rather than picked by hand: strike is one blow's base damage (content/rules/combat.json damage.base), heal is Mend's amount (content/rules/spells.json), guard lasts the Guard move (content/combat/moves.json) and takes the share of a blow a failed block lets through (combat.json defence.failedLetsThrough). Timings are whole 30 Hz ticks. abilities-content.test.ts ties every value to those files.
